title: Mixed Event — Beside Unchanging Warmth — Episode3 Resurfacing Memories

meta.Event Outline: One day in December, Mizuki's sister sends word from abroad that she'll be coming to visit, to Mizuki's delight. Warm memories resurface, of a time long ago when the two of them went shopping together. And so, Mizuki extends an invitation to go once again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Finally, a chance to sit down!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Thank goodness we were able to get a table. The food court was so crowded.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
This place feels like an oasis after walking for so long!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Haha. We did visit quite a few shops.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
But I had a lot of fun.
It's been too long since we last went out shopping together, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I had a lot of fun too!
This sorta feels like old times.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Remember how we used to go out shopping while I wore the clothes you made?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Wow, that really takes me back!
And we'd pick out shoes and things based on what you were wearing, just like today!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: The way you smiled always put a smile on my face.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Even back then, things weren't easy for me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I could forget about all that whenever I went clothes shopping with her.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (After working up the courage to wear the outfit Sis made for me to school...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(I'll be fine, right...?
I mean, she said it looks really good on me...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks...!
My big sister made it for me.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
She did?
That's so cool! It looks like something from a store!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe. She made it using my favorite colors and these frills.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: We even picked out these shoes together.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: But it's kinda weird that you're wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Yeah, why are you wearing that outfit?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: I like wearing these kinds of clothes.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (What's so weird about me wearing cute clothes?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (Is it because I'm not like them...?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (But... There's nothing wrong with that, right?)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (I just have on some clothes that I like wearing...)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (I also don't want everyone telling me I'm weird or whispering behind my back...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: What a coincidence. Are you also on your way home? How was school?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line:
(She made this outfit just for me.
With her own two hands.)

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Mizuki
rows.Line: (Telling her about what happened would make her feel so sad.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I know! Why don't we go do some shopping together...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
To help take our mind off things!
I feel exhausted after a long day of studying, so I want to do something fun!
